project_name: نادي مصباح الطلابي - Misbah Student Club Web App
archetype: Warm Feminine Intellectual - Botanical & Academic Elegance
design_philosophy: نادي مصباح (Lantern / Illuminating Club) combines academic prestige with warm, empowering feminine hospitality. We strictly reject cold corporate tech purples (#7351B7 is forbidden) and generic AI templates. The design blends soft alabaster parchment, warm terracotta rose, luminous desert amber gold, and deep espresso noir for razor-sharp typography. Every layout is mobile-first, tactile, and thoughtfully adapted for right-to-left Arabic reading patterns.

typography_scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-normal leading-[1.2] font-['El_Messiri']
typography_scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.3] font-['El_Messiri']
typography_scale.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm leading-normal text-muted-foreground font-['Tajawal']
typography_scale.overline: text-[11px] sm:text-xs tracking-wider uppercase font-semibold text-amber-800

responsive.mobile_container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

layout.mobile_nav: Fixed bottom-nav bar with 5 key actions on mobile + clean top app bar with logo and notifications. Desktop switches to an elegant glassmorphic top nav or side panel with full role-based tabs.
layout.grid_reflow: All desktop multi-column grids collapse to 1 column on mobile (<640px), 2 columns on tablets (640px-1024px), and 3-4 columns on desktop (>1024px).
layout.hero_mobile: Single column vertical stack on mobile with lantern badge, headline, role preview tabs, and quick email+OTP trigger. Side-by-side on desktop.
layout.dashboard_tabs: Horizontal scrollable pill tabs on mobile with sticky active indicators; full bento grid layout on desktop.

typography.mobile_rule: Headings clamp down by 20-30% on small devices (e.g. text-2xl on mobile, text-4xl on desktop) to prevent clipping in Arabic text. Body text remains 15px-16px for comfortable Arabic reading.
typography.line_height_arabic: Arabic typography requires relaxed line-height (leading-[1.6] to leading-[1.8] for paragraphs) to prevent diacritics and ascenders/descenders from colliding.

overflow_guard.rule: Every main container and view must have `overflow-x-hidden w-full max-w-full box-border`. Tables must have horizontal scroll wrappers (`overflow-x-auto -mx-4 px-4 sm:mx-0`).

tap_targets.rule: Minimum 44px x 44px for buttons, chips, tabs, inputs, and OTP boxes for effortless mobile tapping.

interactive_guidelines.test_ids_rule: Every button, input, tab, card, and actionable item MUST have a kebab-case data-testid attribute in English (e.g., data-testid='login-email-input', data-testid='event-register-button', data-testid='role-switcher-student').
interactive_guidelines.toast_notification: Use sonner for all notifications in Arabic (e.g. 'تم التسجيل في الفعالية بنجاح!', 'تم إرسال رمز التحقق إلى بريدك الجامعي').
interactive_guidelines.rtl_direction: HTML element or App root must specify dir='rtl' and lang='ar'. Flex and grid alignments must respect start/end without forcing left/right.
interactive_guidelines.mock_data_readiness: Provide realistic Saudi/Arab university student names, authentic academic courses (Computer Science, Business Administration, Design, Health Sciences), real workshop titles, and active events so the app feels 100% alive out of the box.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. RTL & Arabic First: Ensure document or main container has dir='rtl' and class font-['Tajawal']. Import Google fonts ('Tajawal', 'El_Messiri', 'IBM_Plex_Sans_Arabic') in public/index.html or src/index.css.

2. Role-Switcher for Seamless Evaluation: Include a prominent, elegant role-switch toolbar (e.g. 'تبديل المشهد: طالبة | مشرفة أكاديمية | إدارة النادي') so the evaluator can test all 3 customized dashboards without logging out.

3. Full MVP Flow: Implement the University Email + OTP login modal, Student Dashboard with My Events & Points, Event Registration with Capacity counter & Comments, Workshop Repository with PDF/Video preview, News Board, and Admin Dashboard with member approvals & events CRUD.

4. Warm Feminine Aesthetic: Strictly use the warm feminine palette (#FDFBF7 background, #F7F2EB sand surfaces, #C86D74 terracotta rose, #D99B26 desert gold, #1E1815 deep espresso). Avoid cold purples (#7351B7 is forbidden).

5. Mobile-First & Tap-Friendly: All cards, action buttons, and nav items must look flawless on 375px mobile screens as well as 1440px desktop screens. Use bottom navigation or sticky header on mobile.
6. Rigorous data-testid: Add explicit data-testid attributes to all buttons, tabs, inputs, modal triggers, and role selectors for resilient automated testing.
